top_signals.title: China Vows to Boost Yuan Liquidity, Back Hong Kong Markets
top_signals.summary: China Vice Premier He Lifeng said China will continue to support a free and open economic environment in Hong Kong and boost offshore yuan liquidity in the financial hub.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Sanctioned Iranian Tanker Slips Past U.S. Blockade, Delivers Cargo to China
top_signals.summary: A sanctioned Iranian tanker carrying about 500,000 barrels of liquefied petroleum gas slipped past the U.S. naval blockade and delivered its cargo to China, according to United Against Nuclear Iran (UANI), which says it filmed the ship at a Malaysian anchorage along the way. top_signals.title: Michigan State cyber incident claimed by ransomware gang behind recent hospital attack
top_signals.summary: A recent post by the BYOD gang appears to line up with a security incident that prompted campus-wide action at Michigan State University. BYOD drew attention in October for an attack on the University of New Mexico.

top_signals.title: Voters expect ‘no difference’ to UK economy after Healey’s modest Budget
top_signals.summary: John Healey’s Budget will make “no difference” to the UK economy, voters have said, as concerns over stealth taxes and defence spending overshadowed a series of giveaways in the Chancellor’s maiden fiscal statement. Polling by City AM/Freshwater Strategy showed that about half of voters expected the Budget to make “no difference” to Britain’s economic fortunes.  [...]
